reserveReview.rationale: Bridge's CASH-specific dashboard, last updated Oct 9, 2026, 2:00 PM UTC, reports 126,450,961 CASH circulating and $126,452,175 reserve assets, with $7,495,318 Cash (5.9%) and $118,956,857 Treasury (94.1%). The dashboard lists the exact authored Solana and HyperEVM contracts. Its Treasury footnote includes money-market funds comprised of T-bill ladders with less than three-month duration; this does not establish a maximum contractual maturity for every asset in the combined bucket. BBI Terms section 02(a) bounds direct Treasury-bill maturities to three calendar months, but the bill share of the combined bucket is undisclosed. The Bridge issuance FAQ corroborates the eligible reserve classes, segregation and issuer self-reporting. No provider weights, direct Treasury versus money-market-fund split, 90-day conversion, or cash/deposit contractual tenor are inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-published CASH dashboard allocation at its Oct 9, 2026, 2:00 PM UTC update: Cash $7,495,318 (5.9%) and Treasury $118,956,857 (94.1%), against $126,452,175 reserve assets and 126,450,961 CASH circulating.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dashboard allocates reserve assets between two published buckets, but the combined Treasury/government-MMF bucket does not establish an instrument-level asset class. It is conservatively classified as other until the direct Treasury versus MMF allocation and fund counterparties are disclosed. Other residual unknowns: issuer self-reporting with no published independent CASH attestation; deposit bank identities; any tokenized-asset usage permitted by eligible classes (e)/(f); and repo holdings within the eligible envelope. No provider weights or synthetic component split are inferred.
